_comment_test_model: Must not appear in tiers: a shared author between oracle and code is flagged oracle_contaminated and excluded from calibration.
_comment_cache_admit_score: A Wilson LOWER bound on cluster mass (invariant #9), not a probability: a unanimous 5-sample tier reports 0.6488 and a unanimous 1-sample tier 0.2698, never 1.0. This is keyed to the NARROWEST tier (1 sample) on purpose — acceptance usually lands on the final tier, which is the narrowest and has no threshold at all, so a higher bar admits nothing on exactly the escalated queries a cache would pay off on. Thin admission is safe because arm zero re-executes every hit (invariant #5), so it costs a wasted verification, never a wrong answer. Omit the key to have it derived from your tiers; anything above the widest tier's ceiling is rejected outright.
